name: Image Exporter
description: Imports images into the editor with 8 methods and 10 light monochrome styles (max. 10,000 objects).

quality.name: Calculation quality (methods 7 and 8)
quality.description: How many candidates are tried for each rotated rectangle. <cy>High</c> is the default; <cy>Maximum</c> is the best but slower. With 3,000 objects or fewer it goes up one level automatically, because there is time to spare.

max-raster.name: Maximum internal resolution
max-raster.description: Maximum side (px) of the working image. Higher = more possible detail, but more memory and time.

alpha-threshold.name: Transparency threshold
alpha-threshold.description: Pixels with alpha below this value are treated as transparent and generate no objects.

color-channel.name: Color channel
color-channel.description: Base color channel of the objects (1010 = black). <cr>Do not change it</c> unless you know what you are doing: the color is applied with HSV on top of this channel.

bleed.name: Overlap between rectangles
bleed.description: Extra units each rectangle is widened by, to avoid thin lines between them.

flip-rotation.name: Flip rotation
flip-rotation.description: If the rotated rectangles (methods 7 and 8) come out rotated the wrong way, enable this.

select-after.name: Select after placing
select-after.description: Selects the imported objects so you can move them all at once.

invert-ink.name: White ink on black
invert-ink.description: Inverts the monochrome styles: white ink on a black background (for dark backgrounds).

black-channel.name: Black channel
black-channel.description: Color channel used for the black ink in the monochrome styles (1010 = black). Only used with "Black and white with channels 1010/1011".

white-channel.name: White channel
white-channel.description: Color channel used for the white paper in the monochrome styles (1011 = white). If the paper does not come out white, change this value. Only used with "Black and white with channels 1010/1011".

ascii-advance.name: ASCII: character width
ascii-advance.description: Units one character takes up at scale 1 in the level font. <cy>Calibrate it</c> if the rows come out wider or narrower than the image.

ascii-aspect.name: ASCII: character height/width
ascii-aspect.description: Height/width ratio of a text cell. With monospaced fonts it is usually between 1.0 and 2.0.

palette-size.name: Light styles: color channels
palette-size.description: How many color channels the light styles use with the color check (half for the bases, half for the ink). More = more faithful colors.

palette-first-channel.name: First palette channel
palette-first-channel.description: Channels are searched upward from this number, skipping the ones the level already uses. After 999 it continues at <cy>1020</c> and goes up to 9999 (1000-1019 are special GD channels and are left alone). <cr>Channel 1 is never used.</c>

palette-size-main.name: Methods 1-8: color channels
palette-size-main.description: How many color channels each image uses in the main methods with the <cy>Channels</c> check (with grays, at most 32 are used).

light-special-channels.name: Black and white with channels 1010/1011
light-special-channels.description: The light black-and-white styles use 2 free channels by default. Enable this to use the special channels 1010 (black) and 1011 (white) instead.

ascii-chunk.name: ASCII: characters per object
ascii-chunk.description: Long rows are split into text objects of this size and placed one after another (this keeps GD from clipping or breaking up the text). In color, shorter pieces are used.

ascii-kerning.name: ASCII: letter spacing
ascii-kerning.description: Spacing between the characters of the text objects (key 488). Leave it at 0 unless the letters come out too far apart or too close together.

dump-ui.name: Save interface diagnostics (txt)
dump-ui.description: Writes <cy>ui-dump.txt</c> to the mod's save folder with EVERYTHING about the interface: all open windows (the mod's, the info box and the settings), every node with its position, size, scale, color and real on-screen box, the literal texts (with the glyphs the font does not have), the real spacing between lines, overlaps and overflows. It saves a snapshot when the window opens, when you switch tabs, when you open info, when you open settings and when an image is calculated. The path appears in a notification when the window opens. Send me that txt to fix the interface.
